libpgs 0.8.1 (MIT), the version used by Jellyfin Web 10.11.11.
Source: https://github.com/Arcus92/libpgs-js
Unmodified npm distribution files: libpgs.js, libpgs.worker.js, LICENSE.
The site adapter supplies an authorized SUP URL and video timing, and falls back
to Jellyfin burn-in when client rendering fails. No PGS decoder is implemented here.
